views.front: Image 1 is a 3D render of Jada, a fictional professional female boxer (not a real or famous person), standing in an A-pose. Image 2 is a close-up of her face for identity only. Redraw image 1 as a photorealistic full-body studio photograph of exactly the same woman: same face, same long black box braids pulled back in a high tight ponytail, same proportions, with the lean, muscular physique of an elite, world-champion-level boxer: defined shoulders and arms, visible abs, strong legs, athletic, not a bodybuilder. Same outfit: plain solid black fitted athletic crop top, plain champagne-gold satin boxing trunks with a wide plain black waistband and black side panels ending mid-thigh, black boxing gloves, white socks and black boxing boots, no logos, stripes, patches or text. POSE IS CRITICAL, copy image 1's A-pose exactly: she stands straight facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, and BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND RAISED OUT TO THE SIDES at about 45 degrees from her body, like a 3D-scanning A-pose mannequin, so there is a wide gap of empty white background between each arm and her torso and the gloves are far outside the hips at upper-thigh height. The arms must not hang down by her sides. Both hands are in the boxing gloves, held as firmly closed fists. Expression: a pronounced, determined, confident smirk: the left corner of her closed mouth is clearly pulled up and the right corner stays level, a slight crease beside the raised corner, no teeth, steady intense eyes looking straight into the camera, brows slightly lowered. Natural skin texture and realistic muscle definition. No logos, text or graphics anywhere. Full body visible head to feet, centered, plain white background, even soft studio lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus.
